rules: Do not replace accepted hardware merely because historical source is inconvenient.
Persist source, commands, results, report and manifest for every experiment.
Do not label model geometry as PEX or fabricated measurement.
Most cells remain physically differentiated; only a small General Reserve population may re-role.
Use dual-time-scale Role Pressure with hysteresis/dwell/fatigue rather than instant queue chasing.
Use break-before-make patch handoff; old patch state may drain through the Local Venule while the new patch becomes active.
Limit local role changes to a developmental wave when correlated switching has no throughput benefit.
Keep Local Venule -> Charge Artery -> regional reservoir -> battery/collector as distinct recovery scales when each pays.
Uncertain population state may remain non-robust; it is not permission to guess.
